newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices jump at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices jump at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices strengthened considerably at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 10,545 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 99 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron gained 5.1 percent to 25.03 rand/kg, 21 micron strengthened by 2.6 percent to 22.34 rand/kg, 22 micron rose 4.4 percent to 20.79 rand/kg, 23 micron gained 5.9 percent to 19.09 rand/kg, 24 micron upped 5.2 percent to 18.25 rand/kg and 25 micron gained 6.1 percent to 17.82 rand/kg.
Prices for Merino bellies rose 6.1 percent to 18.31 rand/kg, Merino lambs gained 2 percent to 23.06 rand/kg and Merino lox was 1.8 percent dearer to 13.94 rand/kg.
